description_expanded:
This one-of-a-kind Alys Beach Vacation home offers an unbelievable experience to all guests. The first-floor courtyard resembles an atrium surrounding a splash pool and hot tub. The spacious, open family room with high ceilings offers ample seating, a dining area and kitchen with large center island. The master suite with a king-sized bed is designed around an open-air courtyard and fountain. A half-bath and small TV den complete the lower level. The second level offers four bedrooms, all with private baths. A large bedroom with a king-sized bed offers separation from the rest of the bedrooms on this level. On an opposite hallway, two bedrooms, each with one full-sized bed, and one bedroom with three single beds are found. The laundry area is also located on the second level. Opening from the second floor, guests in this home will discover a large rooftop terrace with spectacular views, a built-in grill and wetbar area and large outdoor dining area. Finally, one level higher than the terrace, guests will enjoy an incredible rim overflow swimming pool. Parking for this home is located in two marked spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 41 Kings Castle Court. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
